sources.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
sources.title: UK ETS: Hospital and Small Emitter status

facts.source_fact: An HSE may apply to increase emissions targets after an eligible increase in installation capacity.
For installations starting before 2023, the 2026–2030 reference rule requires the capacity increase to be put into operation after 31 December 2023.
For installations starting in 2023, the capacity increase must be put into operation after 31 December 2024.
For installations starting in 2024 or 2025, the capacity increase must be put into operation after 31 December 2025.
An HSE cannot apply for a target increase where its targets were calculated using estimated emissions.
A granted target increase may apply from the year in which the capacity increase was put into operation.
To receive an increase for a scheme year, the operator must apply by year-end or within three months of putting the increase into operation if later.
The application must divide the installation into sub-installations in accordance with FAR article 10.
The application must evidence the capacity increase, its operation date and that it is not temporary.
The regulator grants only where the increase is operational, non-temporary and produces a positive net installed-capacity change; a small-emitter HSE target cannot be increased above 24,999 tCO2e.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve approval gates and target cap.
